stem: Ravi looks at the night sky with his telescope from his home in Jaipur. He sees a small rocky object with an irregular shape moving around the Sun between Mars and Jupiter. It has no tail. What is this object?

teacher.key_rationale: The object is rocky, irregular in shape, orbits the Sun between Mars and Jupiter, and has no tail, so it is an asteroid (B). Comets are icy bodies that develop tails near the Sun; the other options do not match the description.
